$comment: HOW A PLAN LOOKS — the second half of the shared plan card, and the half that is not CSS.
Authored here and copied into the marketing site by its scripts/sync-plan-card.mjs, exactly
like src/styles/plan-card.css. Together the two files are the whole look of a plan card, so a
change on either surface reaches the other on the next build (OPEN-DECISIONS #277).
WHAT IS IN HERE IS SHAPE, NOT TEXT. Prices and quotas come from the database — get_public_plan_
catalogue() and get_public_plan_quotas() — because ARCHITECTURE.md:244 forbids a pricing plan
hidden in code, and that rule does not stop being true for a file that calls itself shared.
Marketing prose stays on each surface in its own language: the marketing site publishes he, en
and fr, the product publishes he, and a file that tried to hold all of it would be a translation
system pretending to be a design token.
So this file holds the four facts that are neither price nor prose: the ticket's printed code,
which of the four faces it wears, which lucide glyph sits in its head chip, and whether it is
the rung the vendor points at. Every one of them is a drawing decision, and every one of them
used to live in a component on one surface only.
`business` IS PRESENT AND THE PRODUCT SURFACES STILL WILL NOT SHOW IT. get_public_plan_
catalogue() excludes it in the server (#194/#201), so the public ladder never receives a row to
draw; the authenticated panel does receive one. Its face is here so that the one surface allowed
to render it draws the same ticket as everything else, not so that a second surface may start.
WHICH RUNG WEARS THE CREAM PAPER — AND WHY THE MARKETING SITE DECIDED IT.
The two surfaces disagreed. The marketing site pointed at PRO (RECOMMENDED = 2 in
PlansChapter.tsx, cream face, badge on it); the product's PLAN_EMPHASIS pointed at PREMIUM,
per OPEN-DECISIONS #202 («ופרימיום הוא הנחשק ביותר»). Two surfaces pointing a visitor at two
different plans is exactly the drift this file exists to end.
Owner ruling 27.08.2026, asked directly and answered directly: «תיישר לפי הדף נחיתה». PRO takes
the cream paper and the badge. This SUPERSEDES the emphasis half of #202 — recorded in
OPEN-DECISIONS #277 so the next reader meets the current answer rather than re-deriving the old
one from a row that is no longer true. The rest of #202 is untouched and still binds: the
emphasis is STATIC and identical for every reader, never keyed to the tenant's own data and
never a personal recommendation.
